_readme: Copy to demo-accounts.local.json (gitignored) to get one-click dev sign-in with YOUR test logins on the Log in page (needs VITE_SHOW_DEMO_ACCOUNTS=true). Never commit real passwords. A blank password makes the button fill in the email only. role: platform_admin (Super Admin) | super_admin (Hospital Admin) | staff_admin | agency_admin | agency | patient.
